## Description

Intraoral X-rays (IOPA/RVG), OPG and intraoral photos uploaded through the documents pipeline (malware scan, time-limited viewer) and attached to one or more teeth and the visit; viewer with zoom, brightness and contrast; before/after comparison. CBCT and DICOM sensor import start as a spike.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** An image can be attached to teeth and opened from the tooth chart.
- [ ] **AC2.** Images never appear in URLs with patient data; links are time-limited (P2-006 rules).
- [ ] **AC3.** A spike records the CBCT/DICOM option and its cost.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
